name: Ethereum beacon chain finality loss
rootCause: Prysm and Teku clients became overloaded processing old-but-valid attestations, so the beacon chain lost finality twice (~25 min and ~1 hour). Blocks kept being produced thanks to client diversity; patches limited the reprocessing.
